captions.detailed: A hydraulic dropper seatpost featuring a dark grey lower body tube clamped near its top by a light grey quick-release binder ring with an integrated lever. An inner silver-grey telescoping post extends upward via a prismatic joint, capped by a two-bolt saddle rail clamp plate mechanism holding a pair of black, round-section rails. The assembly is designed to slide linearly, mimicking the height adjustment of a bicycle saddle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a hydraulic dropper seatpost with a dark lower body tube, a light grey quick-release clamp ring, and an inner telescoping silver post on a prismatic joint. The top should feature a dual-bolt saddle rail clamp mechanism holding two parallel black cylindrical rails.
captions.factory: Construct the lower body using a main Cylinder primitive combined with a smaller bottom cap cylinder and a side-oriented cable port cylinder. Model the quick-release binder ring as a hollowed cylinder with an attached rectangular block and a multi-segmented lever arm. Create the inner post using a slightly narrower cylinder, topped with a rectangular saddle rail clamp plate, two vertical bolts, and two parallel cylindrical rails. Define a prismatic joint between the lower outer tube and the inner telescoping post to enable vertical movement.
